description.value:
The Seeq are a pig-like race that comes in a variety of colors and sizes, making a living as gossipmongers and peddlers in Hume societies.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Seeq gain +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom, and –2 Intelligence.
  • Type: Seeq are humanoids with the seeq subtype.
  • Size: Seeq are Medium creatures.
  • Base Speed: Seeq have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Seeq begin play speaking Common and Seeq. Seeq with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Banganese, Draconic, Giant, Goblin, Terran, Undercommon.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Desert Runner: Seeq receive a +4 racial bonus on Constitution checks and Fortitude saves to avoid fatigue and exhaustion.
  • Hardy: Seeq gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.
  • Stability: Seeq receive a +4 racial bonus to their CMD when resisting bull rush or trip attempts.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Deceptive: Seeq gain a +2 racial bonus on Bluff checks.
  • Perceptive: Seeq gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Sense Motive checks.
  • Scavenger: Seeq gain a +2 racial bonus on Appraise and Perception checks to find hidden objects.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Seeq can see twice as far as a hume in dim light.
